name: TaxBridge-Bench
description: TaxBridge-Bench is a synthetic benchmark for neurosymbolic spreadsheet-to-ledger reasoning in UK Making Tax Digital tax compliance. Version 1.0.0 contains 115 Excel workbooks: 30 evaluation cases (031–060), 40 deployment fixtures for tax year 2026/27, and 45 diagnostic workbooks selected from their manifest. It includes aggregate ground truth, 40 executable deployment specifications and row targets, scoring/harness source snapshots, 40 saved simple-LLM prompts and responses, historical comparison records, a source-file checksum manifest and a data audit. The evaluation truth contains 163 SA103F box totals. The deployment truth contains 259 box totals, 280 flags and 1,069 cumulative quarterly row occurrences. Offline re-scoring of the saved simple-LLM responses reproduces 39/40 valid JSON responses, 56/259 boxes, 178/280 flags and 39/40 VAT-registration flags. Scoring scope matters: the historical blind scorer tests expected aggregate boxes with a category-grouping rule; the deployment release gate tests monetary, period and VAT treatment, with category differences allowed as advisory; the app-path gate tests summary totals; the simple baseline scores boxes and exact flag labels. These success criteria are not interchangeable and do not establish complete ledger correctness. This release contains 350 unchanged source files plus release documentation.
